title: Caribbean Carrot-Ginger Soup
description: Coconut milk, fresh ginger, carrots, and onions star in this Caribbean-inspired vegetarian soup that's sure to bring comfort.
ingredients: 1.5 pounds carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
3 cups low-sodium vegetable broth, or more as needed
0.25 teaspoon salt, or more to taste

steps.text: Heat butter and oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion; cook until translucent, 5 to 6 minutes. Add carrots and ginger; cook for 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir in broth and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, until carrots are very tender, 20 to 30 minutes.

Puree soup with an immersion blender until smooth and creamy, or let cool slightly and blend in a blender, working in batches as needed. Return to heat and add more broth as needed for desired consistency; soup should be thick. Season with pepper and additional salt if needed.
Ladle soup into 4 bowls. Swirl 2 tablespoons coconut milk into each bowl.
